metadata_reviewed.result: Actually read the saved native metadata; preserves common single-book source/DOI, original independent English, complete simplified/traditional Chinese and direct Chinese-based French rewrite, three entry routes and related native destinations. No additional metadata correction needed.

overall_verdict: The six reviewed essays are developed, connected French prose, not compressed notes. Every developed example, qualification and distinction is retained. Three localized changes are needed: restore the subject of the old cannot-not quotation, retain a necessary rather than sufficient condition for autonomy, and fix one grammatical agreement. No paragraph-wide rewriting is required. publication_ready means suitable for publication after the lead applies and checks these recorded corrections; it does not assert that they are already applied.
checks: Recognizing in action is distinct from adopting a premise; neither an externally granted status nor an imposed obligation is introduced.

Old statements under examination remain visibly old statements. In ep02[9], engine is intentionally retained because the canonical Chinese quotation itself uses that English word; the initially considered lexical normalization is withdrawn.
Changing a law and silently dropping it remain distinct; earlier periods are not retroactively erased.
Position-conditioned necessity, casewise departure and normative status are separated; opposition is not made a universal command.
Cost, consequence and price remain distinct; no interpersonal common cost scale, punishment, external title, or obligation to continue is added.
Kantian comparisons keep constitutive universal form, juridical duties, partial rapprochement and distinct starting points/postulates; no new proof bridge is supplied.
Domain-limited zero preserves the distinction between capacity to say no and normative status, action-targeting versus mere assumptions, and diagnostic use versus a judgment guarantee.
Every source paragraph and all title units were actually read; matching counts and emphasis are supplemental mechanical checks, not the quality verdict.
application_status: Lead applied all three suggestions and one additional source-calibrated correction in ep03[6]. This independent non-author reviewer has now actually reread all four complete saved French paragraphs against their complete current canonical Chinese source paragraphs. Passed; no semantic or syntactic issue requiring further amendment found. The reviewer did not edit the French manuscript.

actual_scope.finding: Complete saved paragraph and complete Chinese source read. The cannot-not is now the subject, and its legislative reach is restricted to its bearer. It no longer commands everyone to legislate. The old pragmatic-immunity answer, barrier/door image and philosopher-king counterexample remain intact.

Complete saved paragraph and complete Chinese source read. Il n'y a autonomie que si preserves a necessary condition rather than certifying persistence as autonomy. Motor as enabling condition is still distinguished from force and from the person's own drive. The complete paragraph is natural French.

Additional actual full-paragraph readback of the lead's correction, beyond this reviewer's three original issues. Pratiquer le non-agir translates the cited wuwei without introducing an intention criterion; et ne pas tailler preserves the old examined quotation rather than silently substituting the canonical Daodejing wording. Different laws and their conditions/costs, Laozi's formal position, and Kant as branch rather than case remain fully retained.

Complete saved paragraph and complete Chinese source read. Un seul agrees with fondement and has the correct antecedent. The intelligible and performatively coherent opposition test and the negation-already-enacts-negation argument remain unchanged.
